name: HeLMS-54 (Hubble)
blurb: HeLMS-54, a pair of merging, dust-filled starburst galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: helms54-hubble
story: Two dusty galaxies, each forming stars at a furious pace, are merging in the young universe. Astronomers hope this view also reveals whether other galaxies are gathering around them.

claims.text: HeLMS-54 is a binary hyper-luminous starburst
It consists of two merging galaxies
It is gas-rich and dusty with intense star formation
It is seen in the young universe
The program searches for a surrounding proto-cluster
